statements.text: Given the sheer quality and quantity gap, Chinese AI companies continue to rely on American chips.
statements.venue: Opening statement at Select Committee hearing on chip smuggling

statements.text: This report makes it clear: DeepSeek isn’t just another AI app — it’s a weapon in the Chinese Communist Party’s arsenal, designed to spy on Americans, steal our technology, and subvert U.S. law. We now know this tool exploited U.S. AI models and reportedly used advanced Nvidia chips that should never have ended up in CCP hands.
statements.venue: Select Committee on the CCP press release on DeepSeek report

statements.text: It’s simple: the U.S. must win the AI race. AI is a strategic asset vital to America’s economic and national security, not just another tech trend—it has immense power, and we should treat it that way.
statements.venue: Press release on Advanced AI Security Readiness Act

statements.text: AI can be used as a weapon. From helping cyber criminals to building autonomous systems to injecting Chinese Communist Party propaganda directly to the U.S. public, AI has immense power — and we need to treat it that way.
statements.venue: POLITICO Digital Future Daily, '5 questions' interview

statements.text: Right now, American chips are being smuggled into China and used to train AI models that serve the CCP’s military and surveillance state. And we can’t allow that.
statements.venue: POLITICO Digital Future Daily, '5 questions' interview

statements.text: AI is not just another tech breakthrough. It will shape our economy, our military, our diplomacy, and our national security for decades to come. The stakes are historic. As many have said, this is the space race of the 21st century, but instead of rockets and launchpads, it is driven by algorithms, compute, and data. We are in a new Cold War, and AI is a strategic technology at the center.
statements.venue: Opening statement, House Select Committee on the CCP hearing on AI competition with China

statements.text: Artificial intelligence is the defining strategic asset of the 21st century, and the United States must lead its development, protection, and deployment. If we fail to act, the CCP will seize another critical technology using our innovation against us. That is why we need an America first AI policy, one that defends U.S. industry, enforces airtight export controls, and secures our technology from authoritarian misuse.
statements.venue: Opening statement, House Select Committee on the CCP hearing on AI competition with China

statements.text: For too long, the Chinese Communist Party has exploited weaknesses in our export control enforcement system—using shell companies and smuggling networks to divert sensitive U.S. technology that helps fuel its military advancement and extend its surveillance capabilities to further its repression. That puts our national security and our leadership in artificial intelligence at risk.
statements.venue: Select Committee press release on Chip Security Act

statements.text: Artificial intelligence is the defining technology of the new Cold War. Whether the U.S. or China wins this race will be determined in large part by who has more and better chips. The Stop Stealing Our Chips Act will encourage those who witness chip smuggling to speak out while shielding them from retaliation.
statements.venue: Press release on Stop Stealing Our Chips Act

statements.text: The challenges we face as a nation are only becoming more urgent given the high-stakes technology competition in AI and the CCP’s growing coercion targeting America’s allies and partners.

It is in our national interest for NVIDIA and our other AI champions to succeed, but American companies should never jeopardize our nation’s security by giving Chinese companies access to their most advanced chips. Nvidia must now change its corporate practices and appoint leadership that makes national security its top priority. In Congress we must act quickly to pass bipartisan export control legislation in the year-end national defense bill.

As reports continue to come to light regarding Jensen Huang, NVIDIA, and MegaSpeed, there are clear national security concerns that need to be addressed immediately [...] We need to know the full extent to which our national security has been put at risk. This situation is a prime example of why Congress must immediately pass the AI OVERWATCH Act, Chip Security Act, MATCH Act, and Remote Access Security Act in the NDAA.
